title: TopBrain screening admitted no brain repair trial
claim: The retained five-scan TopBrain development screen admitted no hard brain repair task and ran no coding-agent trial. A two-voxel geometric calibration, three reference-convention-ambiguous contacts and two preserved artery variants do not establish difficult anatomical reasoning. Selected source/score/attachment and calibration sampling checks reproduce without new inference.
limitations: Five selected public training scans and one released model component; no held-out or official-ensemble performance claim.
References assist curation. Contact conventions, reference fragmentation and one reference-background calibration addition remain unadjudicated.
Selected native views and 160 label-score checks do not constitute exhaustive anatomical review. No new medical execution or task promotion.
